::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 25th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 31[^1]
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

I am sending today a third instalment of the [Primer](cmy_books/cmybook_353.qmd) with additions, I hope you have had the others safely. I have sent them to you instead of the printers to save further mistakes and will follow them up with the rest

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
